<svg viewBox="0 0 700 500" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <title>Series Circuit Diagram</title>

  <!-- Dark background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="700" height="500" fill="#282c34"/>

  <!-- Circuit Wires (Path for current flow) -->
  <path id="circuitPath" d="M100 100 L600 100 L600 400 L100 400 L100 100"
        fill="none" stroke="#cccccc" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Battery (Cell) -->
  <g id="battery">
    <rect x="85" y="150" width="30" height="100" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#aaaaaa" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Positive terminal -->
    <line x1="100" y1="150" x2="100" y2="120" stroke="#cccccc" stroke-width="5"/>
    <rect x="90" y="115" width="20" height="10" fill="#cccccc"/>
    <!-- Negative terminal -->
    <line x1="100" y1="250" x2="100" y2="280" stroke="#cccccc" stroke-width="5"/>
    <rect x="95" y="275" width="10" height="10" fill="#cccccc"/>

    <!-- Cell symbols -->
    <line x1="90" y1="170" x2="110" y2="170" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/> <!-- Long line (+) -->
    <line x1="95" y1="180" x2="105" y2="180" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/> <!-- Short line (-) -->
    <line x1="90" y1="200" x2="110" y2="200" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/> <!-- Long line (+) -->
    <line x1="95" y1="210" x2="105" y2="210" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/> <!-- Short line (-) -->
  </g>

  <!-- Bulb 1 -->
  <g id="bulb1" transform="translate(300 100)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="25" fill="#ffcc00" stroke="#e6b800" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="-15" y1="-15" x2="15" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="-15" y1="15" x2="15" y2="-15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bulb 2 -->
  <g id="bulb2" transform="translate(300 400)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="25" fill="#ffcc00" stroke="#e6b800" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="-15" y1="-15" x2="15" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="-15" y1="15" x2="15" y2="-15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Current flow animation (multiple dots for continuous flow) -->
  <circle r="8" fill="#00ffff">
    <animateMotion dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto">
      <mpath xlink:href="#circuitPath"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
  <circle r="8" fill="#00ffff">
    <animateMotion dur="6s" begin="1.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto">
      <mpath xlink:href="#circuitPath"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
  <circle r="8" fill="#00ffff">
    <animateMotion dur="6s" begin="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto">
      <mpath xlink:href="#circuitPath"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
  <circle r="8" fill="#00ffff">
    <animateMotion dur="6s" begin="4.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto">
      <mpath xlink:href="#circuitPath"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>

  <!-- Labels -->
  <text x="100" y="70" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">
    Cell / Battery
  </text>
  <text x="300" y="60" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">
    Bulb 1
  </text>
  <text x="300" y="440" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">
    Bulb 2
  </text>

  <text x="350" y="250" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#00ffff" text-anchor="middle">
    Current (I) is the same everywhere
  </text>
  <text x="350" y="285" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">
    Voltage (V) is shared across components
  </text>

  <!-- Arrows indicating voltage sharing -->
  <line x1="150" y1="280" x2="250" y2="280" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"/>
  <line x1="150" y1="290" x2="250" y2="290" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"/>

  <defs>
    <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="0" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
      <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#ffffff" />
    </marker>
  </defs>

</svg>
